newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Coface credit agency buys into German AKV.
newsitem.headline: French Coface credit agency buys into German AKV.

text.p: French export credit agency Coface said on Monday it had signed a contract with German retailer Rewe to buy a majority stake in credit insurer Allgemeine Kreditversicherung (AKV).
Coface will own 51 percent of AKV, with Rewe Handelsgruppe AG owning 37.4 percent and Munich Re retaining its 12.5 percent holding, the French agency said in a statement.
Coface gave no details of the acquisition price.
AKV is a leading player in the German market for credit insurance, with 1995 turnover of 401 million marks, of which 20 percent was in export credit business, it said.
